My plot is very small, not even a quarter hectare, so one bag of fertilizer is already a big cost for me. I went to primary school so I know NPK and urea help the maize grow, and if I can get the FISP coupon this year I will use it — without the coupon I cannot afford to buy at full price. I put the goat and chicken droppings I collect on the maize because it costs me nothing, and I plant the hybrid seed my neighbor shared with me last year because it gave better cobs. My husband and I work this plot ourselves with the children helping on weekends; we do not have money to hire anyone.
